subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: Which npm install failures should OpenClaw auto-retry or auto-repair, and which should only print guided recovery steps across Bash, PowerShell, local-prefix, and Docker setup paths?
rationale: Current source proves a real diagnostics gap, but retry budgets, npm prefix mutation, TLS/security handling, and optional setup-probe strictness change existing install behavior and need maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow classified policy
options.body: Retry only transient network failures and add platform-specific guidance or approved repair for EACCES, ENOSPC, E404, EBADENGINE, and TLS failures with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

options.title: Guidance-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep installer side effects mostly unchanged while improving messages and docs links for permission, disk, engine, package, TLS, and network failures.

options.title: Keep current partial handling
options.body: Accept current npm code/syscall/errno output plus targeted cleanup retries without a broader structured installer policy.

recommendation.title: Narrow classified policy
recommendation.body: Retry only transient network failures and add platform-specific guidance or approved repair for EACCES, ENOSPC, E404, EBADENGINE, and TLS failures with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current-history signal across the Bash, PowerShell, and Docker setup files involved in the policy choice.
